surface: Claude Desktop consumer Chat with local MCP
prompt_capture_method: Full native AX composer value verified before each send; submitted message also observed, sometimes AX-truncated. Exact text transcribed below.
answer_capture_method: Complete final-answer text transcribed from native AX; formatting and AX whitespace normalized, not a raw Markdown export.
attribution: Expanded native Claude tool cards matched arguments, result/answer, chronological server timestamps, and six audit events. JSON-RPC IDs are server-side, not displayed in the app. Hashes are edit detection, not independent attestation.

limitations: Six development cases, one repeat, one consumer surface, one observed model label.
Narration judgments are non-independent author review, not blinded external grading.
The prompt explicitly asks to use the tool; spontaneous discovery from ordinary user wording was not tested.
No causal no-tool comparison and no replication of the 96-response archive.
Synthetic driver evidence, draft model, offline retained policy; no operational clearance or real driver verification.
Only check_apm_induction was called by the provider. The context tool has local tests but no consumer-provider invocation in this run.
UI automation had focus/clipboard delays before submission; no completed answer was retried.
